acceptance: SSB default resolves to native on platforms with a wheel; legacy remains selectable for at least one minor release.
Golden hashes and the performance gate pass on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64 at cutover time.
context:
Phase 3 SSB cutover (owner decision A3). Separated from Tier 1 and Tier 3 synthetic cutovers so SSB's external pvm-p2/crr-c2 dependencies do not delay unrelated benchmarks.

Parked 2026-11-25 by owner decision: the datagen target is now a BenchBox-owned Rust library (see datagen-adr-rust-library-revision). This item waits for the revised ADR, which decides whether it is rebuilt around the library or dropped.
description:
Per-benchmark cutover (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decision 4) after the SSB stage passes its gates. Library is already a required dependency from the TPC cutover.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
